locations.name: Mercat Municipal de Sóller
locations.description: Sóller's indoor food hall (Mon–Sat 8:00–14:00) plus the Saturday street market spilling through Plaça de la Constitució until ~14:00 — the anchor of the Sep 5 train day. Strategy from the guide: market first (crowds peak 11:00–14:00), buy producer foods and named-maker crafts (orange products, olive oil, honey, sea salt, ceramics) and skip the generic stalls; a market picnic of olives, cheese, bread and gelato is the most spontaneous lunch in town.
locations.address: Plaça des Mercat, 07100 Sóller, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: The Saturday market takes over the center until ~14:00; make it the first priority off the 10:10 train. Best buys: producer foods and identifiable crafts; quality is mixed at the generic stalls.

locations.geocode_query: Mercat Municipal de Soller, Placa des Mercat, Soller, Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: Can Prunera Museu Modernista
locations.description: Sóller's finest Art Nouveau house at the top of Carrer de sa Lluna — original Modernista interiors, modern and contemporary art, and a sculpture-garden café and wine bar you can visit WITHOUT museum admission (€11 self-guided, no advance booking). The guide's café pick for the day: art, garden and a glass of wine in one stop, more curated than the main-square terraces.
locations.address: Carrer de sa Lluna, 86, 90, 07100 Sóller, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: One of the 'best three experiences': the Art Nouveau house with sculpture-garden café. €11 self-guided, no booking; café/boutique/garden accessible without admission. Saturday open from 10:00 — verify posted closing time.
Official visit information: admission, hours, and the café/garden access policy.

locations.geocode_query: Can Prunera Museu Modernista, Carrer de sa Lluna, Soller, Spain

locations.name: Sala Picasso & Sala Miró (Estació de Sóller)
locations.description: Free permanent galleries inside the Sóller railway station itself — 50 Picasso ceramics and 35 Miró engravings. The easiest high-value cultural stop of the trip: you literally walk past it stepping off the 1912 train. 15–25 minutes.
locations.address: Plaça d'Espanya, 07100 Sóller, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: See it when you step off the train: free Picasso ceramics and Miró engravings rooms in the station; no detour, no reservation.

locations.geocode_query: Estacion de tren de Soller, Placa d'Espanya, Soller, Mallorca, Spain

locations.name: Pueblo (Sóller)
locations.description: The guide's #1 Sóller lunch: a stylish seasonal bistro off Plaça d'Espanya — local citrus, vegetables, grilled dishes and cocktails; relaxed but elevated. Listings indicate Friday–Sunday lunch service, which fits the Saturday train day exactly; arrive at noon or reserve for certainty.
locations.address: Plaça d'Espanya, 11, 07100 Sóller, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Ranked #1 for your tastes: 'stylish seasonal bistro… relaxed but elevated rather than formal.' Fri–Sun lunch service; try at noon or reserve.

locations.name: Casa Álvaro
locations.description: Traditional Spanish cooking in central Sóller — tapas, paella, fideuà, croquettes, small terrace. Reported open daily for lunch and dinner: the guide's strongest spontaneous fallback when Pueblo is full (call ahead if you want paella at a set time).
locations.address: 07100 Sóller, Balearic Islands, Spain

references.note: Ranked #2: authentic Spanish cooking and wine; open daily; the strong spontaneous fallback.

locations.name: La Romaguera
locations.description: Contemporary sharing plates, aged steak and Mallorcan wine in a tucked-away street (Carrer de Sa Mar) with a small terrace. Open Saturday lunch, but small enough that walk-ins are uncertain — reserve if it's the pick.

references.note: Ranked #3: contemporary sharing plates in a tucked-away street; its size makes walk-ins uncertain.

locations.name: Biniaraix & the Barranc Steps
locations.description: The guide's best short active option: continue up Carrer de sa Lluna through the citrus groves ~20 minutes to the tiny stone hamlet of Biniaraix (60–90 min round trip with a drink), optionally tasting the opening dry-stone staircase of the Barranc de Biniaraix before turning back. The Sóller-valley version of the Ravello wander — do it INSTEAD of Can Prunera if the afternoon calls for movement, not in addition.
locations.address: 07101 Biniarraix, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Easy village-and-groves walk: Sóller → Biniaraix → Sóller, 60–90 min with a drink; or add the first section of the Barranc staircase. Choose it OR Can Prunera as the afternoon anchor.

locations.name: Ferrocarril de Sóller (1912 train)
locations.description: Vintage 1912 wooden train from Palma through the Tramuntana to Sóller (~1 h each way; ~$46 round trip) — twice endorsed by Sara Caroline Bridgers and the anchor of the Sep 5 Sóller day. Current official timetable: Palma departures 10:10 and 10:50 (take the 10:10 to beat the market wind-down); returns from Sóller at 14:00, 17:15 (confirm at the ticket office), 18:00, 18:30 and 19:30. Buy the train-only return at the station on the day — the online product is the combined train-and-tram ticket. Bonus at arrival: the station's free Picasso and Miró rooms.
locations.address: Carrer d'Eusebi Estada, 1, 07004 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Official timetable: Palma 10:10/10:50 out; Sóller returns 14:00, 17:15 (confirm at office), 18:00, 18:30, 19:30. Train-only tickets sold at the station same-day; online sells the combined train+tram.
Official timetable and fares page.

locations.name: Sóller
locations.description: Golden-stone market town in its citrus valley, ringed by the Tramuntana — the anchor of the Sep 5 Saturday: market and food hall first (crowds peak 11:00–14:00), lunch on a side street rather than an obvious square terrace, then ONE afternoon anchor — Can Prunera for art and garden, or the Biniaraix groves walk for movement — and gelato or wine before the evening train. Modernista façades by Gaudí's disciple Joan Rubió (Sant Bartomeu church and the Banc de Sóller) frame the main square as the tram passes through.
locations.address: 07100 Sóller, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: The Saturday shape: market → Sa Lluna shopping → side-street lunch → Can Prunera OR Biniaraix → gelato/wine → 17:15 or 18:00 train home. Crowded 11:00–14:00; that's the plan working, not failing.

locations.tags: market-town, modernista, saturday-plan, town, tramuntana, valley
